core_obligations: A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 22667-22684): conditions (1), (2), (3) of the criterion are immediate because pi_X^{-1} is exact and fully faithful (by the cohomological descent lemma); for the extension condition, pushing forward the short exact sequence 0 -> pi_X^{-1}F -> G -> pi_X^{-1}F' -> 0 gives an exact sequence 0 -> F -> pi_{X,*}G -> F' -> 0, so pi_{X,*}G is a torsion abelian sheaf and G = pi_X^{-1}pi_{X,*}G lies in A'_X.

Property (item-base-change-P) (proof lines 22686-22693): the class of proper morphisms of finite presentation is stable under base change, by the existence of fibre products and the two permanence lemmas in Morphisms.

Properties (item-restriction-A) and (item-A-sheaf) (proof lines 22695-22701): the first follows from the commutative diagram of the big and small etale topoi in Topologies, the second is the description of the pullback along the comparison.

Properties (item-A-and-P) and (item-refine-tau-by-P) (proof lines 22703-22715): the former combines part (2) of the proper comparison lemma with the torsion of the higher direct images of torsion sheaves; the latter follows because a surjective finite locally free morphism is surjective, proper and of finite presentation, hence an h-covering, and by the dominating cover lemma.
proof_roadmap: Verify that A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory, using exactness and fullness of pi_X^{-1} and the cohomological descent statement.
Check the base change property from permanence of properness and finite presentation.
Identify the restriction and sheaf properties with the topological diagram and the pullback description.
Read off the last two properties from the proper comparison, torsion of pushforwards, and the existence of finite locally free covers.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the five comparison properties of the standing situation for the h-topology over the small etale site, with coefficient subcategories given by pullbacks of torsion sheaves (statement lines 22647-22664). The proof (proof lines 22666-22715) checks the weak Serre axioms for A'_X through exactness and fullness of the pullback together with cohomological descent, and then verifies the five properties one by one from permanence of properness and finite presentation, the topological diagram, the description of the pullback, the proper comparison with torsion of pushforwards, and the existence of finite locally free covers. H2: five property checks with named inputs, all written out.
